name: vllm_gptq_shuffle
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_gptq_shuffle.py. In-place GPTQ exllama weight shuffle: q_weight (rows, (cols//32)*bit) int32 packed weights, q_perm a random permutation of the cols original column indices (int32), bit in {4,8}. q_perm must be a valid permutation so gen_inputs builds it via randperm (cols read from declared q_perm length) and fills q_weight with randint. The op mutates q_weight in place, so run() clones the input, calls _custom_ops.gptq_shuffle, and returns the mutated buffer. Full int32 output compared exactly by the default comparator. Requires vLLM at eval time.
